messages:
Sam: quick standup — did a small followup on the embed-latency alert, dug into the recent spikes. found a noisy client causing big seq lengths; added a short-term rate cap.
Priya: nice, thanks. can you drop the query id in the incidents doc?
Sam: yep added note in the runbook under 'embed-latency' with the example query id and the mitigation.
Kai: FYI I saw a bump in 5xxs last night around 02:13 UTC (inference-5xx). looks like a grpc retry storm from a single old deploy; rolled back the canary.
Jordan: thanks Kai. did we open a follow-up for the client-side retry fix?
Kai: created ticket INF-842 and assigned to platform-client team, pinged on #vendors.
Priya: blockers: still waiting on the autoscaler PR review (perf/autoscale#212). if that doesn't land today we won't be able to increase burst pool for dedicated.
Sam: quick check — can someone take a look at the PR? @Jordan? it's small (changes cooldowns, adds a safety cap).
Jordan: I'll review after standup, aiming in the next hour.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary rollback recorded for inference-service at revision a3f7c2 (trigger: 02:18 UTC).
Priya: today: will update alert thresholds for low-traffic windows and add a note about quieter eval batches to avoid noise. also prepping a short doc for SLO burn impact during rolling restarts.
Sam: I'm going to instrument an extra histogram for seq length bucket distribution so we can tune batching better.
Kai: oncall follow-ups: reminder to check the warmup job after autoscaler changes — kv-warmup sometimes fails silently. I left a temp monitor in grafana.
Jordan: also re: runbooks — added a short checklist for grpc retry detection (logs to search, fields to grep). link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/grpc-retry
Priya: minor FYI: turned off an old alert that was alerting on noisier test traffic from the EU sandbox.
Sam: no blockers for me after Jordan reviews. otherwise handing over to Kai for the evening shift.
Jordan: review done, left 1 small comment on test coverage.
Kai: taking the handover. ping me for anything urgent, will keep an eye on embed-latency and inference-5xx. :thumbsup:
Sam: thanks all.
Priya: thanks — small sync but useful. :coffee:
